name: Fiano Romano (Italy)
description: Vertical bicolour of maroon (red in the blazon) and orange, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Fiano Romano within a yellow wreath, with the inscription COMUNE DI above and FIANO ROMANO below in black.
history: Municipal flag of Fiano Romano, a comune in Lazio; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: Fiano Romano arms — crowned, within a yellow wreath
inscription COMUNE DI above and FIANO ROMANO below the arms
